tools.name: get_key
tools.description: Get the value stored at a Redis key.

tools.name: set_key
tools.description: Set a string value at a Redis key with an optional expiry.

tools.name: delete_key
tools.description: Delete one or more keys from Redis.

tools.name: scan_keys
tools.description: Scan Redis for keys matching a glob-style pattern.

tools.name: expire_key
tools.description: Set a time-to-live in seconds on an existing Redis key.

tools.name: publish_message
tools.description: Publish a message to a Redis pub/sub channel.
